parameters.content:
## WF7: Automated Review Request

🎯 **Purpose:** Automatically sends a friendly review request email to guests ~2 hours after they check out. Good reviews are critical for Airbnb ranking and future bookings.

🔄 **Runs:** Every hour, automatically

🛡️ **Safety:** Only sends once per guest (tracks via Google Sheets). Requires 'Guest Email' to be filled in the DB manually (Airbnb doesn't share guest emails via iCal).

📋 **Required Setup:**
• Add a 'Review Sent' column (TRUE/FALSE) to your Rental Automation DB Sheet1
• Make sure 'Guest Email' column is filled for each booking

⏰ **Hourly Trigger**
Runs every hour. Checks the calendar for any guests who checked out in the last 2-4 hours and haven't yet received a review request.
💡 The 2-4 hour window gives guests time to settle after leaving, making them more likely to leave a positive review.

📆 **Fetch Recent Checkouts**
Fetches all calendar events where the end date (checkout) falls within the last 4 hours.
💡 Uses Google Calendar's iCal sync. We look at events ending today between 'now minus 4 hours' and 'now' to find recent departures.

🔍 **Filter Real Bookings**
Removes Airbnb 'Not available' blocks and other non-guest events from the calendar results.
💡 Airbnb iCal often includes 'BLOCKED' or 'Not available' entries — we only want real guest checkouts.

nodes.name: 🔍 Filter: Keep Only Real Guest Checkouts

parameters.content:
❓ **Recent Checkout Gate**
Checks if any real guest just checked out. If no recent checkouts, the workflow stops here.
💡 Prevents unnecessary processing and DB reads when there's nothing to do.

📋 **Read DB Review Status**
Reads the Google Sheets DB to check which guests have already received a review request email.
💡 The 'Review Sent' column (TRUE/FALSE) prevents sending duplicate review requests if a guest checks out and the workflow fires multiple times.

nodes.name: 📋 Read Booking DB for Review Status & Guest Email

parameters.content:
🧮 **Match Checkout to DB & Check if Review Needed**
Matches each calendar checkout event to its row in the Google Sheets DB.
Checks:
1. Has the review email already been sent? (Review Sent = TRUE)
2. Is there a guest email available?
3. Did the checkout really happen recently?
💡 Only guests with an email AND no review yet sent will proceed.

nodes.name: 🧮 Match Checkout to DB & Check Review Status

parameters.content:
❓ **Review Email Gate**
Final check before sending. If no guests need a review request (already sent, no email, etc.), the workflow stops gracefully.
💡 Prevents any accidental sends.

nodes.name: ❓ Does This Guest Need a Review Request?

parameters.content:
📧 **Send Review Request Email**
Sends a warm, personalised review request email to the guest. References their name and stay at Bryson Road.
💡 Sent ~2 hours after checkout — the optimal window when guests are still thinking about their stay but have had time to settle. Includes a direct Airbnb review link.

parameters.subject: How was your stay at Bryson Road? 🏠
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json.guestName }},

Thank you so much for staying at Bryson Road — we hope you had a wonderful time in Edinburgh! 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿

If you enjoyed your stay, we would really appreciate it if you could take 2 minutes to leave us a review on Airbnb. Reviews mean the world to small hosts like us and help other travellers find us too.

👉 Leave a review: https://www.airbnb.com/

If anything wasn't quite right or could be improved, please reply to this email directly — we read every message and are always looking to make the experience better.

We hope to welcome you back to Edinburgh soon! 🎉

With warm wishes,
The Bryson Road Team

nodes.name: 📧 Send Review Request Email to Guest

parameters.content:
💾 **Mark Review as Sent**
Updates the 'Review Sent' column in Google Sheets to TRUE for this booking.
💡 This is the final step — ensures this guest won't receive another review request on the next hourly check.
